derivation.onset: Onset (6.2, 7.7): ICE 8/10 on 2032-03-19 (Day +4, no sedation) is the earliest qualifying finding under every reading, equal to the record. Same category in all readings, so 7.7.
derivation.max_grade: Max grade (3.4, 7.5, A30, A35, A9): the Day +6 07:30 finding (awakens only to tactile stimulus = Grade 3) is documented in the same note as IV lorazepam given at 02:40, and no clinician statement attributes it either way. If it counts, the maximum is 3 and matches the record (7.7). If excluded, the maximum is 2 (Day +5), so the record's 3 is unsupported (7.3). Different categories, so 7.5, reason attribution.

ambiguity_notes: The attending note's 'A: ICANS post CAR-T' is a general assessment line; it does not say the 07:30 tactile-stimulus finding was due to ICANS rather than lorazepam, so under A9 it is not an attribution statement. If a reviewer reads it as attributing the findings to ICANS, the grade would be 7.7 (Grade 3).

The attending's 10:30 ICE 8/10, 'awake, conversant' is 3 hours after the 07:30 assessment; not 'about the same time', so not a conflicting-assessments case (6.4) but it suggests the drowsiness was transient. Sertraline is not on the competing-cause list (A35); dexamethasone, tocilizumab and levetiracetam are treatment. The Day +9 headache is excluded.
